items.source: Read an object of the given type from the given input message, and returns it.
items.translation: 从给定的输入消息中读取给定类型的对象，并返回它。

items.source: Write a given object to the given output message.
items.translation: 将给定对象写入给定的输出消息中。

items.source: contentType - the content type to use when writing. May be null to indicate that the default content type of the converter must be used. If not null, this media type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: `contentType` - 写入时使用的内容类型。若为 `null`，则表明必须使用转换器默认的内容类型。如果非 `null`，此媒体类型必须已传递给该接口的 canWrite 方法，且该方法必须返回 `true`。

items.source: type - the (potentially generic) type of object to write. This type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true. Can be null if not specified.
items.translation: `type` - 要写入的（可能是泛型的）对象类型。此类型必须先前已传递给该接口的canWrite方法，且该方法必须返回true。如果未指定，可以是null。

items.source: type - the (potentially generic) type of object to return. This type must have previously been passed to the canRead method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: type - 要返回的对象（可能是泛型）类型。此类型必须先前已传递给该接口的canRead方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source: t - the object to write to the output message. The type of this object must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: t - 要写入输出消息的对象。该对象的类型必须先前已传递给此接口的canWrite方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source: contextClass - a context class for the target type, for example a class in which the target type appears in a method signature (can be null)
items.translation: contextClass - 目标类型的上下文类，例如目标类型出现在方法签名中的类（可以为 null）

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze

items.source: This method should perform the same checks as HttpMessageConverter.canWrite(Class, MediaType) with additional ones related to the generic type.
items.translation: 此方法应执行与HttpMessageConverter.canWrite(Class, MediaType)相同的检查，并增加与泛型类型相关的额外检查。

items.source: A specialization of HttpMessageConverter that can convert an HTTP request into a target object of a specified generic type and a source object of a specified generic type into an HTTP response.
items.translation: 一种 `HttpMessageConverter` 的特化，能够将 HTTP 请求转换为指定泛型类型的目标对象，并将指定泛型类型的源对象转换为 HTTP 响应。

items.source: Indicates whether the given type can be read by this converter. This method should perform the same checks as HttpMessageConverter.canRead(Class, MediaType) with additional ones related to the generic type.
items.translation: 指示此转换器是否可以读取给定类型。此方法应执行与HttpMessageConverter.canRead(Class, MediaType)相同的检查，并增加与泛型类型相关的额外检查。

items.source: Indicates whether the given type can be read by this converter.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以读取给定类型。

items.source: Indicates whether the given class can be written by this converter.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以写入给定类。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to read, can be null if not specified. Typically, the value of a Content-Type header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要读取的媒体类型，如果未指定则可为 `null`。 通常是 `Content-Type` 标头的值。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to write (can be null if not specified); typically the value of an Accept header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要写入的媒体类型（如果未指定，可以为 `null`）；通常是 `Accept` 头的值。

items.source: T - the converted object type
items.translation: T - 转换后的对象类型

items.source: true if readable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示可读；否则为 false。

items.source: HttpMessageNotReadableException - in case of conversion errors
items.translation: HttpMessageNotReadableException - 在转换错误时

items.source: type - the (potentially generic) type to test for writability (can be null if not specified)
items.translation: type - 要测试可写性的（可能是泛型的）类型 （如果未指定，可以是 null）

items.source: true if writable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示可写；否则为 false。

items.source: HttpMessageNotWritableException - in case of conversion errors
items.translation: HttpMessageNotWritableException - 在转换错误时

items.source: type - the (potentially generic) type to test for readability
items.translation: type - 要测试可读性的（可能是泛型的）类型

items.source: inputMessage - the HTTP input message to read from
items.translation: inputMessage - 要读取的 HTTP 输入消息

items.source: clazz - the source object class to test for writability
items.translation: clazz - 要测试可写性的源对象类

items.source: outputMessage - the message to write to
items.translation: outputMessage - 要写入的消息。

items.source: the converted object
items.translation: 已转换的对象
